I answered Ilse in her DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **185 seats**.

- **Where it comes from:** Dana Okafor posted the update in #north-team on 20 Aug 2025. Her first message said 180. Two minutes later she corrected it to 185 and said she was updating the Q-Freight sheet. Ilse is a member of #north-team, so she can see this herself.
- **What I couldn't check:** I can't see the amendment document itself, so Dana's correction is the only source. I told Ilse that June Osei-Lark has the signed copy if she wants it confirmed.

A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed. I left out the North cheat sheet and the incident channel because neither gives a seat count.
